title: Lovely Smoky Egyptian Parma Ham Tagine
description: A herbal and silky Egyptian dish featuring Parma ham, perfect for a date night, made with ovo-vegetarian friendly ingredients and served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, and coriander.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the sliced Parma ham to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook the Parma ham for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
While the Parma ham is cooking, fry the eggs in a separate skillet and set aside.
To serve, place a slice of Parma ham on each hot stone plate, top with a fried egg, and garnish with pitted dates.
Drizzle any remaining spice mixture over the top of each dish.
